verdict.rationale: Unit's lending product page says it provides 'flows to automate lending and repayments.' That is a first-party automation capability, but it is scoped narrowly to lending and stated only in one thin marketing line. Nothing describes general user-configurable background automations or schedules. Missing for 10: general-purpose automation or rule builder, recurring/scheduled background execution documentation, evidence that a user (or AI agent) can configure these automations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: with flows to automate lending and repayments
